LanguageData.HE_Yamato_Tatami.label: tatami
LanguageData.HE_Yamato_Tatami.description: Woven rush mats with dark cloth borders, soft underfoot and pleasant to sit on.
LanguageData.HE_Yamato_Gravel.label: raked gravel
LanguageData.HE_Yamato_Gravel.description: White gravel raked into gentle waves. Calming to look at, a little slow to walk across.
LanguageData.HE_Yamato_Ishidatami.label: ishidatami paving
LanguageData.HE_Yamato_Ishidatami.description: Grey stone slabs laid in courses, with moss allowed to grow in the joints. Temple paths and castle courts are paved this way.
